questions.question: 若 F'(x) = f(x)$，则 $\int f(2x-1) dx = ？
questions.solution: $原函数与换元结合。令 u = 2x-1，du = 2dx，dx = du/2。\int f(2x-1)dx = \frac{1}{2}\int f(u)du = \frac{1}{2}F(u)+C = \frac{1}{2}F(2x-1)+C。$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·凑微分换元

questions.question: $\int x \cdot \arctan x \, dx = ？$
questions.solution: $分部积分：令 u = \arctan x, dv = x dx，则 du = \frac{1}{1+x^{2}}dx, v = \frac{x^{2}}{2}$。$\int x\arctan x dx = \frac{x^{2}}{2}\arctan x - \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}dx$。$\frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} = 1 - \frac{1}{1+x^{2}}$，积分得 $\frac{x^{2}}{2}\arctan x - \frac{1}{2}(x - \arctan x) + C = \frac{x^{2}}{2}\arctan x - \frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{2}\arctan x + C$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·分部积分

questions.question: $\int \frac{1}{1+\sin x} dx = ？$
questions.solution: $有理化：\frac{1}{1+\sin x} = \frac{1-\sin x}{1-\sin^{2}x} = \frac{1-\sin x}{\cos^{2}x} = \sec^{2}x - \sec x\tan x$。积分得 $\tan x - \sec x + C$。另法可用万能代换 $t = \tan\frac{x}{2}$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·三角有理式变形

questions.question: $\int \ln\left(x+\sqrt{1+x^{2}}\right) dx = ？$（提示：$\frac{d}{dx}\ln(x+\sqrt{1+x^{2}}) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$）
questions.solution: $分部积分：u = \ln(x+\sqrt{1+x^{2}}), dv = dx$。$du = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}dx, v = x$。原式 $= x\ln(x+\sqrt{1+x^{2}}) - \int \frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}dx$。后面积分 $= \sqrt{1+x^{2}} + C$（凑微分 $d(1+x^{2})$）。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·分部积分

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{1} x\sqrt{1-x^{2}} \, dx = ？$
questions.topic: 定积分计算·换元法

questions.question: $\int \sin^{3}x \, dx = ？$
questions.solution: $拆项：\sin^{3}x = \sin x \cdot \sin^{2}x = \sin x(1-\cos^{2}x)$。$\int \sin^{3}x dx = \int \sin x dx - \int \sin x\cos^{2}x dx$。第一项 $= -\cos x$；第二项令 $u=\cos x, du=-\sin x dx$，得 $\int u^{2} du = \frac{u^{3}}{3} = \frac{\cos^{3}x}{3}$。结果为 $-\cos x + \frac{1}{3}\cos^{3}x + C$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·三角函数积分

questions.question: $\int x \sin^{2}x \, dx = ？$
questions.solution: $先降幂：\sin^{2}x = \frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$。原式 $= \frac{1}{2}\int x(1-\cos 2x)dx = \frac{1}{2}\int x dx - \frac{1}{2}\int x\cos 2x dx$。第一项 $= \frac{x^{2}}{4}$；第二项分部积分（$u=x, dv=\cos 2x dx$）：$\int x\cos 2x dx = \frac{x}{2}\sin 2x - \frac{1}{2}\int \sin 2x dx = \frac{x}{2}\sin 2x + \frac{1}{4}\cos 2x$。整理得结果。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·分部积分·降幂

questions.question: $\int \frac{1}{x\ln x} dx = ？$
questions.solution: $两次凑微分：令 u = \ln x, du = \frac{1}{x}dx$。原式 $= \int \frac{1}{u} du = \ln|u| + C = \ln|\ln x| + C$。关键在于识别 $\frac{1}{x\ln x}dx = \frac{1}{\ln x} \cdot \frac{1}{x}dx = \frac{1}{u}du$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·凑微分

questions.question: $定积分 \int_{a}^{b} |f(x)| dx 与 \int_{a}^{b} f(x) dx 的关系是？$
questions.solution: $定积分的绝对值不等式：\left|\int_{a}^{b} f(x) dx\right| \leq \int_{a}^{b} |f(x)| dx$。当 f(x) 在 [a,b] 上不变号时取等号。这是因为积分是「有向面积」求和，取绝对值可能出现正负相消，而先取绝对值再积分不会相消。
questions.topic: 定积分性质·概念辨析

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin^{4}x \, dx = ？$
questions.solution: $华里士(Wallis)公式：\int_{0}^{\pi/2}\sin^{n}x dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/2}\cos^{n}x dx = \frac{(n-1)!!}{n!!} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}$（n 为偶数）。$n=4$ 时：$\frac{3!!}{4!!} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{3\times1}{4\times2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{3\pi}{16}$。
questions.topic: 定积分计算·华里士公式

questions.question: $\int_{1}^{e} \frac{(\ln x)^{2}}{x} dx = ？$
questions.topic: 定积分计算·换元法

questions.question: $\int \frac{dx}{x^{2}-a^{2}} = ？$（$a > 0$）
questions.solution: $部分分式分解：\frac{1}{x^{2}-a^{2}} = \frac{1}{(x-a)(x+a)} = \frac{1}{2a}\left(\frac{1}{x-a} - \frac{1}{x+a}\right)$。积分得 $\frac{1}{2a}(\ln|x-a| - \ln|x+a|) + C = \frac{1}{2a}\ln\left|\frac{x-a}{x+a}\right| + C$。与 $\int\frac{dx}{x^{2}+a^{2}} = \frac{1}{a}\arctan\frac{x}{a}+C$ 对比记忆。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·有理函数·部分分式

questions.question: $\int \frac{\arcsin x}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}} dx = ？$
questions.solution: $凑微分：\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}dx = d(\arcsin x)$。令 $u = \arcsin x$，则 $\int \frac{\arcsin x}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}dx = \int u du = \frac{1}{2}u^{2} + C = \frac{1}{2}(\arcsin x)^{2} + C$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·凑微分

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{1} x e^{-x} dx = ？$
questions.solution: $分部积分：u = x, dv = e^{-x}dx$，$du = dx, v = -e^{-x}$。$\int_{0}^{1} x e^{-x} dx = \left[-x e^{-x}\right]_{0}^{1} + \int_{0}^{1} e^{-x} dx = -\frac{1}{e} + \left[-e^{-x}\right]_{0}^{1} = -\frac{1}{e} - \left(\frac{1}{e} - 1\right) = 1 - \frac{2}{e}$。
questions.topic: 定积分计算·分部积分

questions.question: $\int_{1}^{2} \frac{dx}{x+x^{2}} = ？$
questions.solution: $拆分：\frac{1}{x+x^{2}} = \frac{1}{x(1+x)} = \frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{1+x}$。$\int_{1}^{2} \left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{1+x}\right)dx = \left[\ln x - \ln(1+x)\right]_{1}^{2} = \left[\ln\frac{x}{1+x}\right]_{1}^{2} = \ln\frac{2}{3} - \ln\frac{1}{2} = \ln\frac{2/3}{1/2} = \ln\frac{4}{3}$。
questions.topic: 定积分计算·有理函数·部分分式

questions.question: $\int x^{3}\sqrt{1+x^{2}} \, dx = ？$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·换元法

questions.question: $\int \frac{e^{\sqrt{x}}}{\sqrt{x}} dx = ？$
questions.solution: $令 u = \sqrt{x}, du = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}dx, \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}dx = 2du$。$\int \frac{e^{\sqrt{x}}}{\sqrt{x}}dx = \int e^{u} \cdot 2 du = 2e^{u} + C = 2e^{\sqrt{x}} + C$。
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·换元法

questions.question: $\int_{-1}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}} \, dx = ？$
questions.solution: **几何意义**：$y=\sqrt{1-x^{2}}$ 表示上半圆 $x^{2}+y^{2}=1$。$\int_{-1}^{1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}dx$ 是半径为 1 的上半圆面积，等于 $\frac{1}{2}\pi \cdot 1^{2} = \frac{\pi}{2}$。也可用三角代换 $x=\sin t$ 计算验证。
questions.topic: 定积分计算·几何意义

questions.question: $\int \frac{2x+1}{x^{2}+2x+3} dx = ？$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·有理函数·配方

questions.question: $设 F'(x) = f(x)，则 \int  x·f(x^{2}) dx = ？$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·凑微分换元

questions.question: $\int  e^x·\sin x dx = ？$
questions.solution: $分部积分两次（循环型）：令 I = \int  e^x·\sin x dx。第一次分部积分后出现 \int  e^x·\cos x dx，第二次分部积分后回到原积分，解方程得 I = e^x(\sin x - \cos x)/2 + C。e^x 乘三角函数是经典循环积分。$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·分部积分·循环

questions.question: $设 \Phi(x) = \int_{0}^{x} e^{t^{2}} dt，则 \Phi'(x) = ？$
questions.solution: $变上限积分求导：\mathrm{d}/\mathrm{d}x \int_{a}^{x} f(t) dt = f(x)。直接代入上限即可：\Phi'(x) = e^{x^{2}}。注意：此积分不能用初等函数表示，但不影响求导。$
questions.topic: 变限积分·变限积分求导

questions.question: $设 Φ(x) = \int_{0}^{x^{2}} \sin t dt，则 Φ'(x) = ？$
questions.solution: $变上限积分的链式法则。上限为 x^{2}，需复合求导：Φ'(x) = \sin(x^{2})·(x^{2})' = \sin(x^{2})·2x = 2x·\sin(x^{2})。一般公式：d/dx \int_{a}^{g(x)} f(t) dt = f(g(x))·g'(x)。$
questions.topic: 变限积分·变上限复合求导

questions.question: 曲线 y = x^{2} 与 y = x 围成图形的面积为？
questions.topic: 几何应用·平面图形面积

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{1} x·arcsin x dx = (   )$
questions.solution: $分部积分：令 u = arcsin x, dv = x dx，du = 1/\sqrt{1-x^{2}} dx, v = x^{2}/2。\int  x·arcsin x dx = (x^{2}/2)arcsin x - (1/2)\int  x^{2}/\sqrt{1-x^{2}} dx。第二项用三角代换 x=\sin t，化简得面积相关的标准结果。定积分 \int_{0}^{1} 结果为 \pi/8。反三角函数积分需熟练三角代换。$
questions.topic: 定积分计算·分部积分

questions.question: $\int 1/(x^{2}+2x+2)dx=?$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·有理函数·配方

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{\pi/2}\ln(sinx)dx=?$
questions.solution: $经典定积分，已知结论\int_{0}^{\pi/2}\ln(sinx)dx=-(\pi/2)\ln2。$
questions.topic: 定积分计算·对称性·特殊技巧

questions.question: $\int 1/(1+cosx)dx=?$
questions.solution: $半角:1+cosx=2\cos²(x/2),原式=(1/2)\int sec²(x/2)dx=\tan(x/2)+C。$
questions.topic: 不定积分计算·三角恒等变形

questions.question: 曲线 y = \sqrt{x}$，$x = 1$，绕 $x$ 轴旋转所得体积 $V = ？
questions.topic: 几何应用·旋转体体积

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{\infty} x^{n} e^{-x} \, dx = ？$（$n$ 为正整数）
questions.solution: $\Gamma \text{函数：} \Gamma(n+1) = \int_{0}^{\infty} x^{n} e^{-x} \, dx = n!$。
questions.topic: 反常积分·伽马函数·递推

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{1}arctanx/(1+x^{2})^(3/2)dx=?$
questions.solution: $令x=tant,化为\int_{0}^{\pi/4}t·costdt,分部积分得(\pi/4-1/2)/\sqrt2。$
questions.topic: 定积分计算·换元加分部

questions.question: 心形线 $r = a(1 + \cos\theta)$（$a > 0$）所围成图形的面积为？
questions.solution: $\text{极坐标面积公式：}S = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi} r^{2} d\theta = \frac{a^{2}}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}(1+\cos\theta)^{2}d\theta$。$(1+\cos\theta)^{2}=1+2\cos\theta+\cos^{2}\theta = 1+2\cos\theta+\frac{1+\cos 2\theta}{2} = \frac{3}{2}+2\cos\theta+\frac{\cos 2\theta}{2}$。$\int_{0}^{2\pi}(\frac{3}{2})d\theta=3\pi$，$\cos\theta$ $\text{和 }\cos 2\theta$ $\text{积分为 }0$。$S=\frac{a^{2}}{2}\cdot 3\pi = \frac{3}{2}\pi a^{2}$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·极坐标面积

questions.question: 摆线 $\begin{cases} x = a(t - \sin t) \\ y = a(1 - \cos t) \end{cases}$（$a>0$）一拱与 $x$ 轴所围图形的面积 $S = ($   $)$
questions.solution: $\text{取 }x\text{ 为积分变量不方便（参数方程），直接用微元法：}dS = y\,dx = y\cdot x'(t)dt$。$S = \int_{0}^{2\pi a} y\,dx = \int_{0}^{2\pi} a(1-\cos t)\cdot a(1-\cos t)\,dt = a^{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}(1-\cos t)^{2}dt$。$(1-\cos t)^{2}=1-2\cos t+\cos^{2}t = \frac{3}{2}-2\cos t+\frac{\cos 2t}{2}$。$S = a^{2}\cdot\frac{3}{2}\cdot 2\pi = 3\pi a^{2}$。$\text{这是微元法在参数方程下的经典应用：}$ $dS = y(t)x'(t)dt$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·参数方程面积

questions.question: 曲线 $y = \sin x$（$0 \leq x \leq \pi$）绕 $x$ 轴旋转所得旋转体的体积为？
questions.solution: $\text{圆盘法（绕 }x\text{ 轴）：}V = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} y^{2}\,dx = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{2}x\,dx$。$\sin^{2}x = \frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$，$V = \frac{\pi}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}(1-\cos 2x)\,dx = \frac{\pi}{2}\left[x - \frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right]_{0}^{\pi} = \frac{\pi^{2}}{2}$。$\text{体积微元：薄圆盘 }dV = \pi y^{2}dx$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·旋转体体积

questions.question: 由曲线 $y = x^{2}$，$y = 0$，$x = 2$ 所围图形绕 $y$ 轴旋转所得旋转体的体积为？
questions.solution: $\text{法一（柱壳法，绕 }y\text{ 轴）：}V = 2\pi\int_{0}^{2} x \cdot y\,dx = 2\pi\int_{0}^{2} x \cdot x^{2}\,dx = 2\pi\int_{0}^{2} x^{3}\,dx = 2\pi\cdot\frac{16}{4} = 8\pi$。$\text{体积微元：柱壳 }dV = 2\pi x \cdot y\,dx$。$\text{法二（垫圈法）：}x=\sqrt{y}$，$y\in[0,4]$，$V = \pi\int_{0}^{4}(2^{2}-(\sqrt{y})^{2})\,dy = \pi\int_{0}^{4}(4-y)\,dy = \pi\left[4y-\frac{y^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{4} = 8\pi$。$\text{两种方法一致，柱壳法在此题更简捷。}$
questions.topic: 几何应用·旋转体体积·柱壳法

questions.question: 底面是半径为 $R$ 的圆，垂直于底面某条直径的所有截面都是等边三角形的立体体积 $V = ($   $)$
questions.solution: $\text{取 }x\text{ 轴沿直径，底面圆方程 }x^{2}+y^{2}=R^{2}$。$\text{在 }x\text{ 处垂直于 }x\text{ 轴的截面：弦长 }2\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}$，$\text{等边三角形面积 }A(x)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(2\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}})^{2}=\sqrt{3}(R^{2}-x^{2})$。$V=\int_{-R}^{R}A(x)dx = \sqrt{3}\int_{-R}^{R}(R^{2}-x^{2})dx = \sqrt{3}\left[R^{2}x-\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_{-R}^{R} = \sqrt{3}(R^{3}-\frac{R^{3}}{3}+R^{3}-\frac{R^{3}}{3}) = \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{3}R^{3}$。$\text{截面法是微元法的直接应用：}dV = A(x)dx$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·已知截面求体积

questions.question: 曲线 $y = x^{2}$（$0 \leq x \leq 1$）绕直线 $y = 1$ 旋转所得旋转体的体积为？
questions.solution: $\text{旋转轴不是坐标轴，微元法的核心是找半径。}$ $\text{旋线上任一点到直线 }y=1\text{ 的距离 }r = 1 - x^{2}$。$\text{垫圈法：}V = \pi\int_{0}^{1} r^{2}\,dx = \pi\int_{0}^{1}(1-x^{2})^{2}\,dx = \pi\int_{0}^{1}(1-2x^{2}+x^{4})\,dx$。$= \pi\left[x-\frac{2x^{3}}{3}+\frac{x^{5}}{5}\right]_{0}^{1} = \pi\left(1-\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{5}\right) = \pi\cdot\frac{15-10+3}{15} = \frac{8\pi}{15}$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·旋转体体积·平移轴

questions.question: 曲线 $y = \dfrac{2}{3}x^{3/2}$ 在 $0 \leq x \leq 1$ 上的弧长为？
questions.solution: $y' = x^{1/2} = \sqrt{x}$。$\text{弧微元：}ds = \sqrt{1+(y')^{2}}\,dx = \sqrt{1+x}\,dx$。$L = \int_{0}^{1}\sqrt{1+x}\,dx = \left[\frac{2}{3}(1+x)^{3/2}\right]_{0}^{1} = \frac{2}{3}(2\sqrt{2}-1)$。$\text{弧长公式也是微元法思想的体现：微小弧段 }ds\text{ 可视为直线段。}$
questions.topic: 几何应用·弧长

questions.question: 曲线 $y = \sqrt{x}$（$0 \leq x \leq 1$）绕 $x$ 轴旋转所得旋转体的侧面积 $S = ($   $)$
questions.solution: $y'=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}$，$\text{弧微元 }ds=\sqrt{1+(y')^{2}}dx = \sqrt{1+\frac{1}{4x}}dx = \sqrt{\frac{4x+1}{4x}}dx$。$\text{侧面积微元：}dS = 2\pi y\,ds = 2\pi\sqrt{x}\cdot\sqrt{\frac{4x+1}{4x}}dx = \pi\sqrt{4x+1}\,dx$。$S = \pi\int_{0}^{1}\sqrt{4x+1}\,dx$，$\text{令 }u=4x+1$，$S = \frac{\pi}{4}\int_{1}^{5}\sqrt{u}\,du = \frac{\pi}{4}\cdot\frac{2}{3}u^{3/2}\big|_{1}^{5} = \frac{\pi}{6}(5\sqrt{5}-1)$。
questions.topic: 几何应用·旋转体侧面积

questions.question: 根据胡克定律，将弹簧从自然长度拉长 2 cm 需用力 1 N。则从自然长度拉长 6 cm 需做的功为？
questions.solution: $F=kx$，$F(0.02)=k\cdot 0.02=1\Rightarrow k=50$ N/m。$\text{功的微元：}dW = F\,dx = kx\,dx$。$W = \int_{0}^{0.06} 50x\,dx = 50\cdot\frac{0.06^{2}}{2} = 50\cdot 0.0018 = 0.09$ J。$\text{注意单位统一：}2\text{ cm}=0.02\text{ m}$，$6\text{ cm}=0.06\text{ m}$。
questions.topic: 物理应用·变力做功

questions.question: 底面半径为 $R$、高为 $H$ 的圆柱形容器装满水（密度 $\rho$）。将水全部从容器顶部抽出，克服重力所做的功为？
questions.solution: $\text{微元法：在距顶部 }y\text{ 处取厚 }dy\text{ 的薄层}$。$\text{体积微元 }dV = \pi R^{2}dy$，$\text{质量 }dm = \rho\pi R^{2}dy$。$\text{该层需提升 }y\text{ 米}$，$\text{功微元 }dW = dm\cdot g\cdot y = \rho g\pi R^{2}y\,dy$。$W = \int_{0}^{H}\rho g\pi R^{2}y\,dy = \rho g\pi R^{2}\cdot\frac{H^{2}}{2}$。$\text{关键是正确建立功微元：}dW = (\text{重力})\times(\text{提升高度})$。
questions.topic: 物理应用·抽水做功

questions.question: 一根均匀细杆，长为 $L$，质量为 $M$。在杆的延长线上距一端 $a$ 处有一质量为 $m$ 的质点。杆对质点的万有引力大小为？
questions.solution: $\text{微元法：取杆上距近端 }x\text{ 处的微元 }dx$。$\text{线密度 }\lambda = M/L$，$\text{微元质量 }dm = \lambda dx = \frac{M}{L}dx$。$\text{距质点 }a+x$，$\text{引力微元 }dF = G\frac{m\cdot dm}{(a+x)^{2}} = \frac{GMm}{L}\cdot\frac{dx}{(a+x)^{2}}$。$F = \frac{GMm}{L}\int_{0}^{L}\frac{dx}{(a+x)^{2}} = \frac{GMm}{L}\left[-\frac{1}{a+x}\right]_{0}^{L} = \frac{GMm}{L}\left(\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{a+L}\right) = \frac{GMm}{a(a+L)}$。
questions.topic: 物理应用·万有引力

questions.question: 底边长为 $a$、高为 $h$ 的等腰三角形薄板，顶点朝上（恰与水面平齐）竖直浸没在水中。水对薄板一侧的总压力 $F = ($   $)$（水的密度 $\rho$，重力加速度 $g$）
questions.solution: $\text{微元法：在深度 }y\text{ 处取水平窄条，宽 }dy$。$\text{由相似三角形：深度 }y\text{ 处条宽 }w(y)=a\cdot\frac{y}{h}$。$\text{压强 }p(y)=\rho gy$，$\text{压力微元 }dF = p\cdot w\cdot dy = \rho gy\cdot a\frac{y}{h}\,dy = \frac{\rho ga}{h}y^{2}dy$。$F = \frac{\rho ga}{h}\int_{0}^{h}y^{2}dy = \frac{\rho ga}{h}\cdot\frac{h^{3}}{3} = \frac{1}{3}\rho ga h^{2}$。$\text{另法：形心法 — 形心在 }\frac{2h}{3}\text{ 深处，面积 }\frac{ah}{2}$，$F = \rho g\cdot\frac{2h}{3}\cdot\frac{ah}{2} = \frac{1}{3}\rho ga h^{2}$。
questions.topic: 物理应用·静水压力

questions.question: 用微元法求由曲线 $y = \sin x$ 与 $x$ 轴在 $[0, 2\pi]$ 上所围图形的面积时，正确的面积微元 $dS$ 为？
questions.solution: $\sin x$ $\text{在 }[0,\pi]\text{ 上 }\geq 0$，$\text{在 }[\pi,2\pi]\text{ 上 }\leq 0$。$\text{面积微元必须是正值，故 }dS = |\sin x|dx$。$S = \int_{0}^{2\pi}|\sin x|dx = \int_{0}^{\pi}\sin x\,dx + \int_{\pi}^{2\pi}(-\sin x)\,dx = 2+2=4$。$\text{若直接用 }\int_{0}^{2\pi}\sin x\,dx=0$，$\text{得到的是「有向面积」而非几何面积。}$

questions.question: 用铁锤将铁钉击入木板。设木板对铁钉的阻力与铁钉进入深度成正比（比例系数 $k$）。第一次击打将铁钉击入 1 cm，若每次击打做功相同，则第二次击打可将铁钉再击入 ($   $) cm。
questions.solution: $F=kx$（$x$ $\text{为进入深度}$）。$\text{功微元 }dW = kx\,dx$。$\text{第一次击打做功：}W_{1} = \int_{0}^{1} kx\,dx = \frac{k}{2}$。$\text{设第一次击打后总深度为 }1$，$\text{第二次后总深度为 }d$，$\text{则总功 }W_{1}+W_{2}=k$。$\int_{0}^{d}kx\,dx = \frac{kd^{2}}{2} = k \Rightarrow d^{2}=2 \Rightarrow d=\sqrt{2}$。$\text{第二次击入深度 }d-1 = \sqrt{2}-1\text{ cm}$。$\text{功微元是微元法的物理应用典范：}$ $dW = F(x)dx$。
